records.gap: The 39 commands have descriptive semantics, but one versioned contract does not yet own inputs, defaults, prohibitions, failures, receipts, and handler identity.
All ten geometric strategies exist; full structured strategy inputs, outputs, assumptions, evidence, and failure contracts are not canonical.
UI commands, Python semantics, feature gates, and agent tools are separate registries with no generated parity owner.
Semantic Plan v1 cannot author a general facility envelope and arbitrary labeled department partition from intent.
There is no restart-safe staged generation graph, durable receipt chain, invalidation model, or cumulative save proposal.
Physical footprints are usable, but many assets lack authored sides, access envelopes, utilities, clearances, and planning-readiness evidence.
Ten strategies are implemented, but no canonical recipe registry composes manufacturing concepts and four structured strategy field groups remain missing.
The bounded server analyzer compares line, L, and U only while the browser implements ten strategy families.
The 827-placement reference factory is not represented as intent, semantic tool selection, receipt, validation, and correction traces.
The generation skill is revision-bound and bounded but assumes one complete preview and has no stage-sliced command knowledge or durable resume context.
